description: Equipements présents sur les canaux de la région Bretagne is a dataset listed in data.bretagne.bzh open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Bretagne. Mobiliers et équipements présents sur les canaux gérés par la Région Bretagne (Canal d'Ille et Rance, Vilaine (de Rennes à Redon), Canal de Nantes à Brest (hors section ligérienne) et canal du Blavet ainsi que les dépendances (rigoles, étangs,...). Coverage: Brittany. Its keywords are données ouvertes, canal, mobilier, banc, table, poubelle. The portal shows 2,554 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ouverte : https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bretagne-bzh-portal.
